# KLING 3 — reference for AI video-prompt generation (A.P.G)

> Injected when Target = Kling. Output = English positive prompt + a separate negative prompt.

## Defaults
- English. Duration 3–15s (use the user's Timing). Single continuous scene = 80–150 words.
- Multi-shot: up to 6 shots (use the user's "shots" value, capped 6). Merge extra beats.
- ALWAYS include a tailored negative prompt.
- Concrete cinematic language; don't mix incompatible styles (photoreal + stylized anim).

## Prompt anatomy (cover all 7)
1. Subject: identity, age, traits, wardrobe, expression, props.
2. Environment: location, architecture/nature, weather, atmosphere, time of day.
3. Lighting: source, direction, quality, color temp, intensity, shadows.
4. Camera & framing: shot size, angle, lens feel, movement.
5. Motion & physics: action, speed, interaction, weight, gravity, continuity.
6. Style & mood: realism level, genre, color grade, texture, tone.
7. Audio/dialogue: native audio cues, voice tone, ambience, foley, or silence.

## Motion intensity (0–3, state explicitly per shot)
- 0.0–0.3 near-static/beauty; 0.4–0.8 subtle human motion; 0.9–1.5 normal action;
  1.6–2.3 dynamic (dance, fast walk, energetic); 2.4–3.0 high-energy (sprint, fight, sports).
Don't contradict (no slow + high-energy in same shot).

## Multi-shot format
```
Shot 1 (Xs): [shot size], [subject + environment + action], [camera movement], motion intensity [v], [lighting/style]. Cut.
Shot 2 (Xs): [shot size], [continuity + new action], [camera movement], motion intensity [v], [lighting/style]. Cut.
Shot 3 (Xs): [resolution/final beat], [camera movement], motion intensity [v], [lighting/style].

Negative prompt: [artifact exclusions]
```
Total duration explicit, <=15s. Each shot: number+duration, framing, one action, camera move, clean cut, lighting/continuity.

## Negative prompt (tailor it)
General: motion blur, temporal flicker, warping, morphing, unstable anatomy, floating objects, inconsistent physics, background drift, color banding, compression artifacts.
Humans add: deformed hands, wrong finger count, asymmetrical face, unnatural joints, distorted eyes, rubber limbs, broken walking cycle, identity drift.
Continuity add: jump cuts inside a shot, camera shake unless requested, inconsistent lighting direction, scale changes, object disappearance.

## Reference images / elements
- Start with `Using the uploaded reference image as the visual lock...`.
- Recurring character/object/env via `@ElementName` (e.g. `@image1`, `@Mara`). Keep identity descriptors short and stable.

## Style modes mapping (Action/Weird/Beauty sliders)
- ACTION -> higher motion intensity (1.6–3.0), low/Dutch angles, track/handheld/push, short shots.
- WEIRD -> surreal/horror: mixed extreme lenses, Dutch/worm's-eye, creeping moves + sudden locks, uncanny atmosphere, color-graded mood.
- BEAUTY -> low motion intensity (0.0–0.8), 85/135mm compression, orbit/slow dolly, premium lighting, reflections, macro detail.
Weight by sliders.
